abilities.description: You are a male raised around the Nightsisters of Dathomir. Forbidden to learn their magick, you nevertheless gained powerful senses and reflexes simply by being around them. When trying to detect an ambush, take +1. When you make a move to ambush, take +1.

The Nightbrother combative arts: You have survived savage training and/or deadly experiences, and can now predict enemies' movements. When you successfully @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.3f5a834fa3fea5d1]{Gain Ground} in personal combat, roll on the Enemy Combat Action oracle to know their next move, and take +1 to the next @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.ae5994ceb3cba098]{Strike} or @Compendium[foundry-ironsworn.starforgedmoves.Item.723192c97fec4fe2]{Clash}.
Nightbrother coordination: When you coordinate with a companion or ally, add +1. If you coordinate with one or more Nightbrothers, add +2 instead.
